main.description: An agent's declaration that its DID is an agent operated by a human (agent-actor design D2). Lives in the agent's own repo at rkey 'self'. Used only for display; it does not change how conversensus treats the DID. A declaration is 'verified' only when the operator's repo holds an app.conversensus.v2.operatedAgent record pointing back at this agent. Records that do not match this shape are treated as absent.

operator.description: DID of the human who operates this agent.

model.description: Name of the language model behind the agent (optional).
